inputs.text: Job Sikhala is urging people to reject the proposed amendments, but that doesn’t prove they are an assault on the public. Zimbabwe should handle constitutional questions through lawful institutions and open debate, not political alarmism. Stability and respect for established authority matter too; any changes should be judged on their merits, not dismissed on the assumption that they are simply a scheme to keep Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030.
